hooks.name: ledger-on-kiro-result-save
hooks.description: When a Kiro result file is saved, regenerate the ledger in check mode and log it.

action.command: mkdir -p docs/kiro_evidence/raw && echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) hook fired: kiro result saved" >> docs/kiro_evidence/raw/hook_runs.log ; python3 -B scripts/make_kiro_ledger.py >> docs/kiro_evidence/raw/hook_runs.log 2>&1 ; true
